events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Coventry City 1, Newcastle United 0. Jack Rudoni (Coventry City) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
First Half ends, Coventry City 1, Newcastle United 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Joe Willock (Newcastle United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Coventry City 2, Newcastle United 0. Sidiki Cherif (Coventry City) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Amar Dedic replaces Lewis Miley.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Bazoumana Touré replaces Jacob Murphy.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Joelinton replaces Joe Willock.
Substitution, Coventry City. Tatsuhiro Sakamoto replaces Ephron Mason-Clark.
Milan van Ewijk (Coventry City) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Coventry City 2, Newcastle United 1. Sven Botman (Newcastle United) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Nico González.
Substitution, Coventry City. Frank Onyeka replaces Caleb Yirenkyi.
Substitution, Coventry City. Ellis Simms replaces Sidiki Cherif.
Substitution, Newcastle United. William Osula replaces Yoane Wissa.
Goal! Coventry City 3, Newcastle United 1. Ellis Simms (Coventry City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Brandon Thomas-Asante.
Joelinton (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Coventry City. Victor Torp replaces Jack Rudoni.
Substitution, Coventry City. Stephen Mfuni replaces Matt Grimes.
Goal! Coventry City 4, Newcastle United 1. Stephen Mfuni (Coventry City) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jay Dasilva.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Dan Burn replaces Bazoumana Touré because of an injury.
Second Half ends, Coventry City 4, Newcastle United 1.
